name: Mel Shumway
occupation: Lincoln County commissioner (current term continues past 2026)
prior_offices: Lincoln County commissioner (won the November 2024 general election after a 2022 primary loss; listed on the official commissioners page)
background: Mel Shumway is a Lincoln County commissioner. He won the November 2024 general election, and the official commissioners page lists him as a member. SVI-NEWS reported that Jake Long and Jesica Lozier will join him on the board in January 2027.

sources.name: SVI-NEWS, Nov. 3, 2026, 2026 Lincoln County General Election Results
